'''House Syrush''' was the estate of the [[House Syrush|noble family]] of the same name in [[King's Pass]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. However, the [[Ruur Killik Burrows]] were located in the mountains behind the estate, and the [[Ruur]] hive overran the estate when the tunnels were broken open.
